name: Behavior & Gesture Design
purpose: Define repeatable physical behavior and pressure responses that can be directed visually.
scope: Bounded art_world capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for behavior_gesture_design.
Execute the bounded operation: Define repeatable physical behavior and pressure responses that can be directed visually.
Apply behavior_gesture_design-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to continuity_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run behavior_gesture_design on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask behavior_gesture_design to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
